senses.gloss: to be successful, prosper; to become fit.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 20:11">Targ. Jer. XX, 11</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 28:13">Targ. Prov. XXVIII, 13</cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 79a:13">B. Mets. 79ᵃ</cite> <he>נְצַלְּחֵיה לציבי וכ׳</he> let him chop it into chips and use it.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 113b:10-11">B. Kam. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>זבין … לצַלָּחָא</he> bought a palm, in partnership with a gentile, to chop it up (and divide it).
<cite ref="Shabbat 119a:2-4">Sabb. 119ᵃ</cite> <he>רבה</he> … <he>מְצַלְּחֵי וכ׳</he> Rabbah and R. J. used to chop wood themselves (in preparation for the Sabbath). Ib. 129ᵃ; a. e.

senses.gloss: to pass through; to do a thing successfully; to prosper.
units: Targ. O. Deut. XXVIII, 29. Targ. ib. XXIX, 8 (O. ed. Vien. Pe.). Targ. O. a. Y. I ib. XXXII, 15 אצ׳ תקוף succeeded in gaining strength.

<cite ref="Menachot 43a">Men. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>וא׳ עיסקייהו</he> and their business prospered.
